content.rendered:
The Hand ✋of God-Part 3 (Con’d from Nov. 15th)

Ezra 7:28 KJV
And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. ??And I was strengthened as the hand of the Lord my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

Ezra 7:28 MSG
Not only that, he caused the king and all his advisors and influential officials actually to like me and back me. My God was on my side and I was ready to go. And I organized all the leaders of Israel to go with me.

??You will find favour, kindness before great men & women.

?? The Lord will extend mercy unto you this week before great men and women and all who have the capacity to do you good.
They will be gracious unto you because of the mighty Hand ✋ of God upon you.

They will like you and back you up with all your pressing needs and cause you to excel in Jesus name ????
